methods.what: Separation ansatz: displacements as combinations of cos σz, cos τz times derivatives of λ(x,y)
Separation constant relations between σ, τ, m, θ
Difference of squares of wave numbers
Substitution λ1=c(τ+σ), λ2=c(τ−σ) and product relation
Transcendental frequency equation from boundary conditions at z=c
Expressing ρ and coefficients in terms of λ1, λ2
